tasks.title: Build a Sentence
Recycling Awareness Event
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently joined a student organization at your university that focuses on environmental conservation. The group is planning an upcoming event to raise awareness about recycling and reducing waste. You have some ideas for activities and would like to share them with the group leader, Julia.
bullets: Describe your ideas for the awareness event.
Explain why you believe these activities will be effective.
Offer to help organize and implement the activities.
tasks.subject: Ideas for recycling awareness event
tasks.sample:
Dear Julia,

As a new member of our environmental conservation group, I have been thinking about ways to make the upcoming recycling awareness event more engaging. I would like to propose a campus waste audit and a week-long zero-waste challenge, plus a table in the student center where people can learn how to sort paper, plastic, and food waste.

These activities should work well because they are hands-on. Students can see how much they throw away and practice the sorting rules we want them to use in the dorms. A short challenge also gives people a reason to try the new habits for more than one afternoon.

I am happy to help draft a simple timeline, book a table, and staff the event. Please let me know if any of these ideas fit the plan, and I can start on the details this week.

Best regards,
Alex Chen
tasks.analysis: 邮件需覆盖三点：活动点子、为何有效、主动帮忙落实。称呼 Julia，不要用 Dear Sir or Madam。

tasks.title: Conformity
tasks.instruction: Write a discussion response. An effective response contains at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Diaz
professor.text: Conformity means behaving in ways that match what others in a group expect. It can influence how people dress, speak, or make choices. Some researchers believe conformity keeps society peaceful and organized. Others argue that it limits personal expression and original thinking. Do you believe conformity is mostly helpful or mostly harmful to individuals and society? Explain your opinion clearly.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: I believe conformity helps maintain social harmony. When individuals conform to societal norms, it can reduce conflict and foster cooperation. This in turn leads to a more stable and cohesive community. I see this in my neighborhood, where everyone helps each other out.

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: I think conformity suppresses individuality. By always trying to fit in with the group, people may avoid expressing their own perspectives. This seems to happen in social media quite often, where posts often just sound like repetitions or echoes of others.

tasks.sample: I agree with Paul that some conformity keeps daily life workable, but Claire is right that too much of it flattens original thinking. Traffic rules, classroom turn-taking, and quiet hours in a dorm are useful forms of conformity: they reduce conflict so people can live together. The problem starts when the same habit is applied to ideas. On social media, repeating the popular take can feel safe, yet it hides disagreement that a community needs. In my view, conformity is mostly helpful for shared routines and mostly harmful when it stops people from saying what they actually think. The useful skill is knowing which kind of situation you are in.
tasks.analysis: 需表态并回应 Paul 与 Claire。较好答法：日常规范有益，思想从众有害，并举例。
